text:
Maria Ramos: Nightly eval for model v20.2-int4 shows a big uptick in codegen hallucination rate on promptset 'dev-codex-anchors' — failure rate 18% vs 2% yesterday. @here
Nightly Eval Bot: nightly-run-2445551234 completed. Dashboard: https://redwood-infer/evals/2445551234 — failing prompts: [p-1023, p-1089, p-1102]. Metrics: codegen_halluc=0.18, pass_rate=0.82, avg_token_score=-1.2
Chang Li: Did we change tokenizer normalizer in this build?
Devon Patel: There was a weights-only update + new tokenizer merges in PR #8234 landed yesterday. I suspected token offsets might shift.
Oliver Grant: Reproduced locally with quant pipeline. Command:
```
./eval_runner --model v20.2-int4 --prompts dev-codex-anchors --seed 42 --n 200
```
I see the same failing prompt p-1102 — generation inserts extraneous helper function that wasn't in FP16.
Anya Sokolov: Is the regression present on unquantized FP16 v20.2?
Maria Ramos: FP16 looks fine (ran on g4dn), failure ~2%. Issue only in int4 quant on dedicated staging node A. Logs: tokenizer outputs token IDs different for the prefix on p-1102.
Devon Patel: Could be tokenization + quantization interacting. Maybe BPE merges changed boundaries causing KV cache alignment diff.
Chang Li: Quick diff of tokenizer table shows 3 new merges around 'malloc' token. Rolling back normalization helps in a small test.
Oliver Grant: Patch to try: switch to v20.2 weights + previous tokenizer mapping (v20.1 tokenmap). Can someone run nightly with that combo?
Nightly Eval Bot: Canary deploy triggered for combo w/ rollback. Build 2445552000 queued.
Devon Patel: Also check detokenization / special token IDs. Seen off-by-one in kernel when using int4 packing.
Maria Ramos: Adding failing example (trimmed):
```
PROMPT: "Write a C function to reverse a linked list..."
GENERATED (v20.2-int4): "void reverse(node **head) { // allocate buffer ... free(head); return; }"
EXPECTED: correct reversal algorithm, no free on head pointer
```
Oliver Grant: :eyes: This looks like a substitution with 'free' token staying in vocab boundary.
Anya Sokolov: If it is token boundary, we should run a micro-eval where we compare token sequences between FP16 and INT4 to see divergence point.
Chang Li: On it — pushing script to compare tokens.
Devon Patel: If we confirm tokenizer change + int4 kernel interaction, plan = revert tokenizer merges for patch release and re-run quant pipeline with updated kernel fix.
Maria Ramos: Thanks, team. Assigning owners: Chang for tokenizer diff, Devon for kernel trace & quant packing, Oliver for repro cases. We'll follow up after canary results. :thumbsup:
Nightly Eval Bot: Canary result: build 2445552000 failed on p-1102, pass_rate 0.78. Rollback candidate scheduled 2445553000.
